splash.title: SPLASH
splash.intro: Frogs go on auction for one UTC day. The highest bid wins the frog and its permanent name.
splash.guest: Open RADA from Telegram to bid, submit a frog or claim a win.
splash.noRound: The first round has not opened yet.
splash.emptyRound: No frogs are on auction this round. Submit one for the next round.
splash.roundRule: A round lasts one UTC day, from 00:00 to 24:00 UTC.
splash.roundClosing: This round is closing. Bids reopen in the next round.
splash.youAtTop: Your bid is at the top
splash.bidFor: Place a bid on the frog by {{author}}
splash.raiseBidFor: Raise your bid on the frog by {{author}}
splash.bidAmountHint: Bid more than the top bid to lead.
splash.bidRaiseHint: Your current bid is {{amount}}. A new bid cannot be lower.
splash.nameRule: 1 to 32 letters, digits or _, starting with a letter. The name can never change.
splash.nameAvailable: This name is free right now.
splash.nameUnchecked: The name could not be checked. You can still try.
splash.nameRequired: Enter a name for the frog.
splash.promise: A bid is a promise, not a payment: no tokens leave your wallet now. If you win, you pay this amount in JPEGPE when you claim the frog.
splash.burnRule: Claim and pay before the end of the next round. An unpaid win burns: the frog is gone and its name is released.
splash.bidPlacedContested: Your bid is placed. Another frog in this round has a bid with the same name; the higher winner gets it.
splash.submitIntro: Add your artwork to the pond. It goes on auction in the next round.
splash.submitLimits: PNG, JPEG or WebP. On this device it is converted to PNG, at most 1024 px per side and 2 MB. A solid background is removed after upload. Up to 5 frogs per 24 hours.
splash.submitted: Your frog is in the pond.
splash.backgroundKept: The background was kept: it is not a single solid colour.

prepare.unsupported: This file cannot be used. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
prepare.too_small: This image is too small. Each side needs at least 64 px.
prepare.too_large: This image cannot be made smaller than 2 MB. Choose a simpler image.

splash.unnamedWin: Won frog, name chosen at claim
splash.claimExplain: You pay exactly the winning bid in JPEGPE from a wallet linked to your profile. The RADA payment window shows the amount, recipient and network fee before you confirm.
splash.claimDone: Paid. The frog is now yours.
splash.claimPending: Payment sent. Waiting for the network to confirm it; this can take a few minutes.
splash.claimCancelled: Payment cancelled. You can try again before the deadline.
splash.claimBurned: This frog burned: no payment was confirmed before the deadline.

state.openNote: Claim before the deadline or the frog burns.
state.confirmingNote: A payment was sent but the network has not confirmed it yet. It counts if it landed before the deadline.
state.expiredNote: Claiming is closed. The frog burns unless a payment confirmed before the deadline is found.
state.claimedNote: The frog is in your collection under its permanent name.
state.burnedNote: It was not paid in time. The frog is gone and its name was released.

splash.emptyResults: No frogs were on auction in this round.
splash.noBidsBack: Back in the pond for the next round

governance.title: DAO
governance.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
governance.advisory: Votes are advisory. The steward makes the binding decision and publishes a public reason.
governance.eligibility: Only verified current members can create proposals and vote. You can read proposals, tallies and decisions.
governance.voteLocked: Vote changes and withdrawals are disabled for this opening.
governance.evidenceNote: Evidence is recorded by the steward; it is not an independently verified payment confirmation.
governance.privacy: Only public frog names are shown. Private voters remain anonymous, with a receipt for every vote version.
governance.futureSettings: Changes apply only to future voting openings. Existing openings keep their frozen settings. A public reason is required for every change.

rule.allow_majority_override: Allow a decision against the majority
